dedupe_keys.name: system identification of offshore wind turbines for model updating and validation using field measurements

description: Gebel, Jakob and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. An existing bottom-fixed turbine in the Belgian North Sea is modelled using design information and scaled reference models. Operational modal analysis of drivetrain vibration and blade strain identifies eigenfrequencies for model calibration; SCADA data provides additional operational validation. The model then estimates blade pitch-bearing lifetime across wind conditions. A related LiDAR-based blade-root/bearing paper is grouped as a field-based fatigue assessment component, with exact shared measurement periods unproven. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. This record represents the documented application and its stated scope. Publication access does not imply that its underlying measurements or implementation are public. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
